vendor.title: Diagram-MMU: A Multi-Modal Benchmark for Scientific Diagrams
vendor.teaser: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been growing the capability for scientific writing and collaboration. For example, OpenAI Prism is a free workspace for scientific writing and collaboration.

vendor.title: LMM Modality Transfer: A Pre-requisite for Autonomous GIS Agents
vendor.teaser: AI models are becoming increasingly adept at understanding and processing spatial information, thereby facilitating agentic problem-solving in spatial tasks and workflows. However, most of the research on their spatial capabilities (e.g., spatial reasoning) has focused on the textual modality as input and output.

vendor.title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
vendor.teaser: OpenAI and AWS are making Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock to support enterprise security workflows.

vendor.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
vendor.teaser: Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data. We introduce Mimir v1, a 1-billion-parameter language model based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture, that is trained from scratch and delivers highly competitive performance for English and sets a new state of…

vendor.title: Govern Replit at scale
vendor.teaser: New Admin API, Audit Logs, and Workspace Settings give organizations more insight and flexibility into how they adopt AI with Replit. Replit helps teams turn ideas into working software quickly.

vendor.title: Amazon Quick now supports customizable no data messages for visuals
vendor.teaser: Amazon Quick announces support for no data message customization, enabling authors to replace the default "No data to display" message with a tailored message when a visual returns no data.

vendor.title: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) is now supported on Vercel CDN
vendor.teaser: Vercel CDN now supports Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) for domains managed by Vercel DNS, encrypting the hostname in the TLS handshake with nothing to configure.

vendor.title: Scale Customer Support With AI Agents: 5 Service Tips For SMBs
vendor.teaser: Your customers deserve fast, personal service — here's how AI agents are delivering it.

vendor.title: The 4 primary roles of AI in automated workflows
vendor.teaser: My in-laws have wired every light in their house to Alexa. But no one can ever remember if they're sitting in the "living room" or the "family room," so three commands and one accidental playlist later, someone always ends up just leaning over and hitting the light switch.

vendor.title: Amazon SES click tracking now supports custom URL paths for mobile app deep linking
vendor.teaser: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) now makes it easier to support mobile deep linking with the new ses:custom-path HTML attribute.

stories.title: MIT BLRU, IBM SkillsBuild Launch AI Lab to Accelerate Research and Democratise AI Skills
stories.teaser: MIT Bengaluru and IBM have opened a new artificial intelligence laboratory featuring high-performance computing equipment designed to make AI research and education more accessible across India. The facility, called MAHE Intelligence GPU, was inaugurated at MIT's Bengaluru campus and can simultaneously support 30 high-performance computing tasks.

stories.title: US to tell partners they must pick sides in AI race
stories.teaser: The United States is preparing to pressure dozens of countries to choose between joining an American-led artificial intelligence coalition or participating in China's competing AI framework. Washington launched the Pax Silica initiative last year to secure supply chains for AI semiconductors and critical minerals, and about two dozen countries have joined, including Japan, Australia, and South Korea.

stories.title: US To Tell Partners They Must Pick Sides in AI Race With China
stories.teaser: The United States is planning to require dozens of countries to choose between joining an American-led artificial intelligence coalition or aligning with China's competing framework. According to a draft State Department letter reviewed by Reuters, countries cannot participate in both initiatives simultaneously.

stories.title: Microsoft eyes September launch for Maia 300 AI chip
stories.teaser: Microsoft plans to launch its next-generation Maia 300 artificial intelligence chip as early as September, according to reports. The company is working to expand its in-house AI chip capabilities and reduce dependence on Nvidia's expensive processors.

stories.title: Two CityUHK scholars elected to the European Academy of Engineering in recognition of their internationally acclaimed research achievements
stories.teaser: Two scholars from City University of Hong Kong have been elected to the European Academy of Engineering. Professor Li Wen Jung from the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Professor So Hing Cheung from the Department of Electrical Engineering received this honor in recognition of their research achievements.

stories.title: US to tell partners to pick side in AI race with China
stories.teaser: The United States is preparing to pressure approximately 35 countries to choose between joining an American-led artificial intelligence coalition or aligning with China's competing framework. Washington launched the Pax Silica initiative in 2025 to secure supply chains for semiconductors, AI models, and critical minerals.

stories.title: Global Times: China advances global AI governance on all fronts, turning principles into deeper, more concrete action
stories.teaser: China is advancing artificial intelligence governance globally through comprehensive domestic development and international cooperation. At the 2026 World AI Conference, President Xi Jinping emphasized guiding AI development with human wisdom and international consensus.

stories.title: Government of Kerala Partners with SAS to Strengthen Social Welfare Schemes Delivery using Artificial Intelligence
stories.teaser: The Government of Kerala has partnered with SAS, a global data and artificial intelligence company, to improve how social welfare programs are delivered across the state. Kerala State IT Mission selected SAS as a strategic analytics partner to strengthen governance and service delivery through advanced data analytics capabilities.

stories.title: NACDC 2026 Concludes at UBC, Advancing Global AI & Technology Research
stories.teaser: The North American Conference on Computational Intelligence, Data Science and Cloud Computing concluded on August 12, 2026, after three days at the University of British Columbia in Vancouver. The event was hosted by the Institute of Engineering and Management in Kolkata, India, along with partner organizations.

stories.title: IFSCA Grants Nexent Capital GIFT City Investment Banking License
stories.teaser: Nexent Capital IFSC Private Limited, the GIFT City-based subsidiary of U.S.-based Nexent Capital Management, has received formal registration from the International Financial Services Centres Authority to operate as an investment banker in India's International Financial Services Centre. The registration was granted on July 31, 2026, under the Capital Market Intermediaries Regulations, 2025, allowing the firm to…

stories.title: Microsoft may reveal next-generation AI chip next month
stories.teaser: Microsoft is expected to announce its next-generation Maia 300 artificial intelligence chip as soon as September, according to reports. The company first introduced its Maia chip in November 2023 but has fallen behind competitors like Google and Amazon in developing custom AI processors.

stories.title: PSU Major DFCCIL Awards Letter of Acceptance to Magellanic Cloud Limited Subsidiary, Deepening Pan-India PSU Portfolio
stories.teaser: Magellanic Cloud Limited announced that its subsidiary, Provigil Surveillance Limited, received a contract worth 3.73 crore rupees from Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited, a government-owned railway company. The contract involves supplying, installing, testing and maintaining an electronic surveillance system along a section of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor over five years.
